# openwrt_dhcp_dnsmasq (Resource)

Manages DNS/DHCP settings (dnsmasq) for OpenWrt.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `authoritative` (Boolean) Only respond to DHCP requests for this device.
- `cachesize` (Number) DNS cache size.
- `confdir` (String) Additional configuration directory.
- `domain` (String) Local domain name.
- `domainneeded` (Boolean) Require domain names to be valid.
- `ednspacket_max` (Number) Maximum EDNS.0 packet size.
- `expand_hosts` (Boolean) Add local domain suffix to hostnames.
- `leasefile` (String) DHCP lease file path.
- `local` (String) Local domain for DNS queries (e.g., '/lan/').
- `localise_queries` (Boolean) Answer DNS queries based on the subnet of the requester.
- `localservice` (Boolean) Only serve DNS to local subnets.
- `readethers` (Boolean) Read /etc/ethers for static leases.
- `rebind_domain` (List of String) Domain whitelist for rebind protection (e.g., ['example.com']).
- `rebind_localhost` (Boolean) Allow DNS rebind for 127.0.0.1.
- `rebind_protection` (Boolean) Enable DNS rebind attack protection.
- `resolvfile` (String) DNS resolver configuration file path.
- `server` (List of String) Upstream DNS servers (e.g., ['8.8.8.8', '1.1.1.1']).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: dhcp/dnsmasq.
